system.description: When a rule or ability requires you to spend a Fabula Point, you may instead choose a Bond and replace an emotion of Admiration, Affection or Loyalty with one of Inferiority, Mistrust or Hatred — and ignore that cost. A second route to paying costs in something other than the intended currency, and it reaches any Fabula Point cost rather than just spells. Self-limiting only while the character has positive emotions left to spend.
